orientation: direction geometry helpers preserves incoming vertical orientation when inserting an L-bend
spike: direction geometry helpers removes out-and-back spikes
buried: direction endpoint clipping clips buried endpoints to source and destination node boundaries
corner: direction endpoint clipping moves straight side-to-side endpoints away from node corners
duplicates: direction endpoint clipping duplicates snapped endpoints so renderer clipping becomes a no-op
approach: direction endpoint clipping snaps renderer endpoints to the boundary entered by the approach segment
